title: Could it be that he, Stephen Dedalus, had done those things?
html_source:
The speaker really distances himself from Stephen here—think of taking a step back and looking at everything in its entirety.

In doing this, it makes the question of whether Stephen had done those things so much more pressing, as the speaker comes across as finding it pretty unbelievable with having to really consider this. Could it be that he… had done those things?

anchor.text: Could it be that he, Stephen Dedalus, had done those things?
anchor.prefix: s closely about him, covered his face again with his hands. He had sinned. He had sinned so deeply against heaven and before God that he was not worthy to be called God’s child.
anchor.suffix: His conscience sighed in answer. Yes, he had done them, secretly, filthily, time after time, and, hardened in sinful impenitence, he had dared to wear the mask of holiness before
